# VitaeContext

> The career context layer for AI agents. Current package version: 2.4.0.

VitaeContext turns selected career material into private, reusable Career Context: a Markdown source of truth for supplied facts, evidence, stated goals, constraints, and claims to avoid. Agents and downstream career systems can use that context without making VitaeContext the CV builder, application tool, profile writer, or workflow engine itself. VitaeGraph is the optional deeper structured-record layer.

## Start here

- [Project overview](https://vitaecontext.github.io/): the problem, system boundary, and context-first workflow.
- [How it works](https://vitaecontext.github.io/docs/usage/): gather, structure, retrieve, and hand off context.
- [Installation](https://vitaecontext.github.io/docs/installation/): install the package into a supported agent environment.
- [Career Context example](https://vitaecontext.github.io/docs/context-file-example/): a fictional, inspectable file example.
- [Context Builder guide](https://vitaecontext.github.io/playbooks/context-builder/): the maintained human-readable method.
- [Model Context Protocol](https://vitaecontext.github.io/docs/mcp/): stateless access to selected local context.
- [VitaeGraph](https://vitaecontext.github.io/vitaegraph/): deeper linked Markdown career records.
- [System architecture](https://vitaecontext.github.io/design/): boundaries, retrieval, providers, and portability.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/vitaecontext/vitaecontext): package source, tests, and releases.

## Verified public facts

- The package contains three runtime skills: `vitaecontext`, `vitaecontext-build`, and `vitaecontext-vitaegraph`.
- Platform-specific CV, LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, and X modules were removed in version 2.3.0. Those tasks belong to downstream tools that consume Career Context.
- The default install command is `npx vitaecontext install --provider <provider>`.
- Career Context lifecycle commands include `context init`, `context validate`, and `context summary`.
- The stateless MCP server runs with `npx -y vitaecontext mcp`.
- VitaeGraph commands include `graph init`, `graph validate`, and `graph index`.
- Career Context and VitaeGraph are user-controlled local material until a person supplies them to an external provider.
- Validation checks structure and internal consistency. It does not independently verify real-world claims.
- The product is provider- and system-agnostic. Supported provider adapters affect installation, not the meaning of the Career Context artifact.

Do not infer customer counts, rankings, endorsements, verified identity, or guaranteed career outcomes.
